case.title: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
case.briefing: The new PX pump series needs shaft SH-220 (1.4021). Two suppliers quote: a German job shop and a Polish machining company. Lead time must not exceed 42 days; the line needs parts within 35 days, every day later costs EUR 150. Machined shafts are a leverage category: several capable suppliers, the goal is the lowest total cost. Award one.

sup:DEMO-J1.subject: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
sup:DEMO-J1.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We can offer you a price of €17.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

As a small shop, we like to keep things practical and clear for our customers. Everything is set up on our end to run your parts efficiently, and we look forward to working together on this order.

Let us know if this works for you so we can get started.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
message.body:
Dear Ms Aigner,

Thank you for your quick and clear offer for the SH-220 shaft. We appreciate your practical approach and would like to work with you on this part.

To be transparent, we are comparing two offers:

Another supplier has offered EUR 16.00 for this part (offer:DEMO-C1-0).

To make an award to you possible, we have prepared three options:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 15.13; payment 60 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option B: unit price EUR 14.69; payment 45 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option C: unit price EUR 15.03; payment 30 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.

Option C keeps your payment terms exactly as you proposed. Options A and B trade a longer payment term for the price, so you can choose what suits your shop best.

We look forward to hearing which option works for you.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
message.body:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your options and are glad to accept the shorter lead time of 35 days.

Our updated Angebot stands at a price of €16.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP.

To move closer to your price expectations, we must maintain EXW terms, as DAP delivery adds significant costs. Alternatively, with delivery EXW: €16.00 per unit, a price of €16.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery EXW.

Please note that our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL. Any further step needs approval from our management. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

Thank you for your updated offer and for accepting the shorter lead time. We value the constructive way you are working with us.

Option A: unit price EUR 14.47; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option B: unit price EUR 14.05; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option C: unit price EUR 14.42; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days; Incoterm DAP.

Option A gives you a longer payment term in exchange for the price. We hope this makes it easy to present to your management.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
message.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thanks for being straight with us about the other offer. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Our current offer is a price of €15.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days, delivery DAP. As a small shop, cash flow is tight right now, so we really have to stick to the 30 days payment term. We can do the DAP delivery you asked for and meet you at €15.70 per unit for Option C. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH
